description_for_human: Search and discover AI development tools and open-source GitHub repositories.
description_for_model: Reporium indexes 1,825 AI development tools and open-source repositories across 28 categories. Use this plugin to discover, evaluate, and analyze repositories for any GitHub username. Returns enriched metadata including repository stats, categorization, tags, and relationship graphs. Query the API to search repos, fetch user portfolios, analyze trends, and identify gaps in tooling landscapes.
